metadata.description: Frontend Developer & Gameplay Programmer Portfolio | Jose Isaac Cambronero Valverde

hero.value_proposition: Simplifying technical complexity with high-quality solutions, designed to meet the most demanding deadlines.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm Isaac, a developer driven by creating tailor-made digital experiences. What started with modding video games evolved into a solid career as a Frontend Developer with a Backend foundation, while in parallel, cultivating a passion for Gameplay Programming as a hobby.
about.p2: My professional journey began during my university years, allowing me to accumulate over 4 years of real experience facing technical challenges, managing clients, and optimizing user experience. Today, I combine my technical profile with skills in 3D animation, multimedia content creation, and music composition to build comprehensive and memorable digital products when required or possible.

list.title: Soulutions Platform
list.description: Web platform designed to centralize and empower environmental and community initiatives in Costa Rica. Enables transparent fundraising with real-time milestone tracking. I led the project's technical recovery, rebuilding the business logic and core services, as well as implementing many other new ones.

list.title: Landing Page | Tecno Air Cold
list.description: Landing page focused on conversion and digital positioning. Includes service presentation, testimonials, and a simplified direct contact system. I prioritized the user experience to facilitate client acquisition within a tight deadline.

list.title: ERP System | Tecno Air Cold
list.description: Internal application to optimize operational management. Includes attendance control, automated payroll calculation, and a technical service module for scheduling visits and generating automated maintenance reports.

list.title: Booking System | King of Kings
list.description: Comprehensive solution for barbershops with two synchronized platforms. Includes a client portal for booking with real-time validation and an admin panel for monitoring business metrics and agenda management.

list.title: Eureka Ticket
list.description: Complete platform for ticket sales and event management. Covers everything from commercialization and ticket transfers to security access control via on-site scanning.

list.title: Conta Fast
list.description: Technical modernization of a legacy electronic invoicing platform. Updated the technology stack, implemented security enhancements (RBAC), and optimized integration with the Ministry of Finance.
